title: Tidy the route search after review
summary: The route search now keeps each cell's cost from the start in its queue and skips cells whose cost is already final, so it calls the distance estimate less often. A route's reported cost is now the true sum of its steps, whatever the estimate returns at the goal. Routes between two points still cost the same, though some equal-cost routes now take a different path. The architecture guide now says that +x is east and +y is north, and that a GPS adapter must convert its heading to match. The 78 navigation tests pass.
next: Get the program lead's answer on the search's stored values and on a blocked start in the entry corridor or after an abort. Then place the stop points in back-and-forth rows and chain a_star from the start pose through each stop, marking unreachable stops.
